label: Beliefs
title: Beliefs | Church Assembly in Westminster
description: The complete original Statement of Faith of Church Assembly in Westminster.
heading: Statement of Faith
intro: We Believe according to the Holy Bible that:

sections.heading: Statement of Faith
statements: There is one God who is the Father, the Son Jesus Christ, and the Holy Spirit, in Whom we are one;
God alone is self-existing and eternal;
All Scripture is inspired by God, for men spoke as they were moved by the Holy Spirit;
All have sinned and come short of the glory of God;
When the appropriate time came, God sent His Son, born of a woman;
The Virgin Mary bore a Son who was conceived of the Holy Spirit;
The Son as the Word with God in the beginning was God; yet He became flesh and dwelt among us;
He was named Jesus because He saves His people from their sins;
God laid on Him the iniquity of us all, making Him sin on our behalf;
Christ was crucified for our sins, was buried and was raised the third day, according to the Scriptures;
All who confess Jesus as Lord and believe that God has raised Him from the dead, will be saved;
Jesus is coming again to judge the living and the dead and to receive the believers to Himself.
